AboutHero.alt_img: Buddhist philosophy and comfort at Buddha Mystic
AboutHero.description: A meticulously designed space where time seems to stand still. At Buddha Mystic, we have created the perfect refuge for you to escape the routine and enjoy an incomparable rest, surrounded by the serenity of Buddhist philosophy.

OurStory.p1: The Buddha Mystic Hotel is born under an aesthetic concept inspired by the harmony and beauty of Buddhist philosophy. Our identity, however, stems from a very special anecdote.
OurStory.p2: Its founder had a dream in which two imposing Buddha statues appeared to him, indicating that in his next project he should incorporate an identical figure. Surprisingly, days later, during a trip to the city of Medellín, he came face to face with the exact same sculptures he had dreamed of.
OurStory.p3: With great astonishment, he decided to take them with him. Months later, the opportunity arose to create this hotel, thus materializing that vision and giving rise to what we know today as an exclusive refuge designed for comfort and total disconnection.

OurValues.val1_desc: An atmosphere inspired by Buddhist philosophy, carefully designed to envelop you in absolute comfort.
OurValues.val2_desc: Our vocation is attention to detail. We work tirelessly to make every moment of your stay impeccable.
OurValues.val3_desc: Facilities created to guarantee restful sleep and total disconnection, ideal for getaways as a couple or family.

OurTeam.member2_desc: Their commitment and charisma guarantee an environment of trust and operational excellence throughout the hotel.
OurTeam.member3_desc: With a great heart and vocation for service, it is the first smile that makes you feel at home.
OurTeam.member4_desc: Transforms our contemporary traditional food into an art that nourishes the body and soul.
OurTeam.member5_desc: Bases their work on honesty and respect, guiding each culinary experience with grace.
OurTeam.description: A team made up of strong men and women, with a great heart and an admirable vocation for service. Together, they build an environment of trust to always give you the best.
OurTeam.banner_desc: Behind every detail is a team of wonderful people who take on their work with love and responsibility. We are all part of your experience.

Restaurant.heroDescription: Where the abundance of Antioquian tradition meets the subtlety and balance of Buddhist philosophy.
Restaurant.philosophyText: At Mandalas, we believe that gastronomy is a way of feeding not only the being, but also the soul and the heart. Our concept is born from a profound respect for the ingredients that sprout from our Antioquian lands, which are elevated through the precision, balance, and ancient techniques inspired by Buddhist philosophy. Every bite is designed not only to nourish the body, but to delight the spirit and anchor you in the present moment.
Restaurant.evolutionText: Currently, our culinary team is immersed in the creation of a new menu. We are refining every recipe, exploring new ingredients, and designing experiences that will surprise your palate. Very soon we will reveal our new gastronomic proposal.

individual.name: Single Room
individual.description: A refuge designed for the solo traveler seeking to reconnect with themselves. This minimalist space offers the perfect balance between comfort and silence, allowing the mind to rest without distractions.

pareja.name: Couple Room
pareja.description: An intimate sanctuary created to strengthen bonds and find serenity in company. Every detail, from the lighting to the textures, is designed to inspire tranquility and profound rest for two souls.

superior.name: Superior Suite
superior.description: Our Superior Suite elevates the resting experience with premium finishes and a spatial arrangement that invites deep peace. The ideal space for an unforgettable stay, enveloped in subtle luxury.

triple.name: Triple Room
triple.description: A space designed for small families or intimate groups looking to share quality moments. Its dimensions offer the necessary comfort to coexist in complete harmony.

cuadruple.name: Quadruple Room
cuadruple.description: Ideal for the modern family. This room offers the necessary spaciousness so that each guest finds their own corner of rest without losing the warmth and connection of the group.

sextuple.name: Sextuple Room
sextuple.description: A generous environment designed to accommodate large families. A refuge where coexistence and laughter harmonize with the subtle, clean, and relaxing design of the Buddha Mystic essence.

octuple.name: Octuple Room
octuple.description: Designed to accommodate large groups in a single unified space. Its majestic dimensions ensure absolute comfort for all members, promoting collective rest.

acomodacion-10-pax.name: 10 Pax Accommodation
acomodacion-10-pax.description: A collective sanctuary perfect for retreats and meditation groups. It allows uninterrupted coexistence and spiritual or group work, keeping our promise of peace intact.

acomodacion-12-pax.name: 12 Pax Accommodation
acomodacion-12-pax.description: Our most majestic stay. A spacious and brightly lit room that honors the power of community. Ideal for holistic retreats where everyone's rest flows in a single environment.

hacienda-napoles.title: Hacienda Nápoles
hacienda-napoles.tagline: A sanctuary of life and transformation
hacienda-napoles.description: What was once a symbol of opulence is today the largest theme park in South America, dedicated to the conservation of species, historical memory, and family enjoyment under the Magdalena Medio sun.
hacienda-napoles.history: Located in the heart of our region, Hacienda Nápoles has been completely transformed into an environmental preservation center. Its extensive plains now house the largest herd of hippos outside of Africa, as well as ostriches, rescued felines, and lush flora that has reclaimed its territory.
hacienda-napoles.location: Doradal, Antioquia (10 min from Buddha Mystic)
details: Access to water parks (Victoria Falls, Cobras)

santorini.title: Colombian Santorini
santorini.tagline: The Mediterranean in the heart of Antioquia
santorini.description: A fascinating labyrinth of immaculately white facades and blue doors that capture the sunlight of Doradal, creating a magical atmosphere of peace that evokes the Greek coasts.
santorini.history: This beautiful urbanization, open to the public, was born as an architectural whim inspired by the Cyclades islands of Greece. Over time, it has become the visual icon of the region, offering highly photogenic corners and a unique serenity for those who walk its alleys.
santorini.location: Doradal, Antioquia (5 min from Buddha Mystic)
details: Afternoons of local coffee and gastronomy

rio-claro.title: Río Claro Reserve
rio-claro.tagline: A marble canyon sculpted by time
rio-claro.description: Immerse yourself in a refuge of incomparable biodiversity where crystal-clear water winds through a majestic white marble canyon. The perfect place for both silent contemplation and adventure.
rio-claro.history: This private nature reserve was created to strictly protect the region's karst ecosystems. Its immense rock formations are millions of years old and house fascinating endemic species, such as the enigmatic Guácharo bird.
rio-claro.location: Medellín - Bogotá Highway (40 min from Buddha Mystic)
details: Level I and II Rafting (Suitable for beginners)

cascada-san-juan.title: San Juan Waterfall
cascada-san-juan.description: Let yourself be enveloped by the deafening yet relaxing sound of water falling from the heights. Dive into natural pools of fresh water, completely surrounded by the vibrant green of the forest.
cascada-san-juan.history: A natural refuge maintained by locals for years. This spa is fed by pure tributaries born in the virgin mountains of the Magdalena Medio, offering crystal-clear waters that invite deep relaxation and total disconnection.
cascada-san-juan.location: San Juan Hamlet (30 min from Buddha Mystic)

rio-magdalena.title: Magdalena River
rio-magdalena.description: Navigate the most imposing and important waterway in the country. Feel the immensity of this body of water while the sun paints the sky in golden and purple hues, creating an unforgettable spectacle.
rio-magdalena.history: The Great Magdalena River has been the route of communication, commerce, and culture in Colombia since pre-Columbian times. Navigating its waters is connecting with the historical memory of an entire nation, listening to the stories of local fishermen.
rio-magdalena.location: Puerto Triunfo (20 min from Buddha Mystic)
details: Local history tales with native fishermen

rio-la-miel.title: La Miel River
rio-la-miel.tagline: Serenity and flow in emerald waters
rio-la-miel.description: A journey through serene currents and mesmerizing emerald green waters. A pristine setting that invites you to both silent contemplation and revitalizing swimming in a wild environment.
rio-la-miel.history: Descending from the high mountains of the central mountain range, the La Miel River carves exuberant landscapes along its path. It is nationally recognized as one of the cleanest and most beautiful rivers in the region, guarded by dense walls of vegetation.
rio-la-miel.location: La Dorada / Norcasia (1h 20 min from Buddha Mystic)
details: Typical lunch prepared by the river
